Rename a repository or change its description

Rename a repository (--name) and/or change its description (--description;
an empty one clears it). What is not named keeps its value.

A rename moves the repository's URLs: every client, CI job and build file that
uses the old name stops working, so rp asks for confirmation on a terminal. In
a script pass --yes; with --no-input or without a terminal, and no --yes, a
rename exits 2 and changes nothing. A description change needs no
confirmation.

```
rp repo update <name> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --description string   New description, at most 500 characters; empty clears it
      --name string          New name of the repository (asks for confirmation)
```
